cues: The liquid touches the glass all the way round a circle of length two pi r.
Along that line, surface tension pulls along the liquid surface, at the angle of contact theta to the wall.
Its vertical part, T cos theta per unit length, lifts the liquid.

text: Why? Look at one tube. The liquid touches the glass all the way round a circle of length two pi r. Along that line, surface tension pulls along the liquid surface, at the angle of contact theta to the wall. Its vertical part, T cos theta per unit length, lifts the liquid. The upward force is two pi r T cos theta.
